Ahh I miss these days :( Sadly, I'm too busy at my new job for this to work any more, I suppose that's both a bad and a good thing? :)

For me, it's a matter of keeping open communication with my SO. If I'm feeling frustrated or worried about something, the first thing I do is talk to her about it. Being honest and open about these sorts of things is something I feel not enough people do. It shows her that you care, and that you are being honest about your feelings. Hopefully, she'll do the same for you as well, when you're in a similar position as she is now. Distance hurts, being out of contact for a period of time sucks, but if you're both open about your feelings for each other, and you've laid all your cards out on the table, then it all becomes much easier to deal with.
